# OMLU

> OMLU is restaurant software for QR ordering, kitchen display, staff operations and billing, built by Nadha Labs for restaurants in India.

## Public pages

* [OMLU](https://omlu.in/): Official OMLU website.
* [FAQ](https://omlu.in/faq): Answers to common questions about OMLU.

## About

OMLU is built by Nadha Labs, founded by Kailasanadh G in 2025.
